summary: Join us in building innovative embedded solutions for next-generation devices. As an Embedded Development Lead, you will lead design and implement low-level embedded systems software, focusing on Board Support Packages (BSP), boot loaders, and power management.
responsibilities: Led design and implement embedded software for BSP, boot loaders, and power management.
Develop and optimize code for bare-metal and low-level embedded systems.
Work with peripheral devices and interfaces such as USB, serial flash, and I2C.
Debug and root cause complex system-level issues to ensure product stability.
Collaborate with hardware and firmware teams for seamless integration.
Contribute to Bluetooth-based product development and real-time operating systems like FreeRTOS or Zephyr.
Work on audio technology-related products as an added advantage.
required_skills: Experience in leading team of Engineers
Extensive hands-on experience in embedded C programming and data structures
Strong background in bare-metal and low-level embedded systems programming
Proven debugging and root cause analysis skills for complex issues
Experience with BSP development, boot loaders, and power management
Familiarity with peripheral interfaces (USB, serial flash, I2C)
nice_to_have_skills: Exposure to Bluetooth-based products and RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr)
Prior experience with audio technology products
benefits: Flexible work options and a collaborative environment.
Continuous learning and certifications in emerging technologies.
